content: भुजिष्य [भुज्-किष्यन्] Independent. .{@-ष्यः@} .²1 A slave, servant. .²2 A companion. .²3 The string worn round the wrist. .²4 A disease (रोग). .{@-ष्या@} .²1 A hand-maid, maid-servant, female slave; अथाङ्गदाश्लिष्टभुजं भुजिष्या <ls>R. 6. 53</ls>; <ls>Mk. 4. 8</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 290</ls>. .²2 A harlot, prostitute; ददर्श कामिनं कञ्चिच्छूद्रं सह भुजिष्यया <ls>Bhāg. 6. 1. 59</ls>.
